title: Submap-Based Indoor Navigation System for the Fetch Robot
authors: Y. Chen; B. Leighton; H. Zhu; X. Ke; S. Liu; L. Zhao
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Deep_Learning_Odometry to ensure precise positioning.
